description_expanded: 🌴 Paradise Pete’s | 3 King Suites | Hot Tub | Bikes | Near Beach & 30A Dining 🌴⭐ Top Reasons Guests Love Paradise Pete’s✔ 3 King Master Suites – ideal for couples & multi-family stays✔ Only 550 yards to Palms of Dune Allen East Beach Access✔ Private Hot Tub Spa perfect for winding down✔ Pet Friendly 🐾 ($250 non-refundable fee; restrictions apply)✔ 4 Bikes Included – explore Scenic 30A with ease✔ Gourmet Kitchen with oversized island & seating✔ Community Pool just steps away✔ 0.7 miles to Gulf Place Town Center (shops, dining, live music)✔ Sleeps up to 16 with flexible sleeping options✔ Professionally Managed with 24/7 Guest Support________________________________________🏖 Welcome to Paradise Pete’sStep into your perfect 30A escape at Paradise Pete’s, a beautifully designed coastal retreat in Dune Allen Beach. From the moment you arrive, the open-concept layout, abundant natural light, and warm beach tones set the stage for a relaxing and memorable stay.Designed with both comfort and connection in mind, this home is ideal for family vacations, friend getaways, and multi-generational trips.________________________________________🍽 Chef-Inspired Kitchen & Open LivingThe heart of the home is the gourmet kitchen, featuring a striking cement island, ample prep space, and seating that flows seamlessly into the dining and living areas. Whether you’re whipping up beach snacks or hosting a full family dinner, this space is built for gathering.Large windows bring the outdoors in, creating an airy, coastal vibe throughout the main living level.________________________________________🛌 Spacious Sleeping for Everyone (Sleeps 16)With three king master suites and multiple bunk options, everyone gets space to unwind:Bed Configuration• Master Suite 1 (Main Level): King Bed• Master Suite 2 (3rd Floor): King Bed + Twin Bed w/ Trundle (Sleeps 4)• Master Suite 3 (3rd Floor): King Bed• 3rd Floor Common Area: Queen Sleeper Sofa• Ground Floor Bunk Area:o 2 Twin-Over-Full Bunkso 2 Twin Trundles (Sleeps 6)Each master suite includes its own en-suite bathroom, providing privacy and convenience for adult guests.________________________________________🛁 Luxe Touches & Thoughtful Extras• Spa-like primary bathroom with stand-alone tub & walk-in shower• Hardwood floors throughout• Cozy third-floor sitting area• Ground-floor game & hangout space________________________________________🌿 Outdoor Living at Its BestUnwind in your private hot tub overlooking a peaceful green space — perfect after a beach day or sunset bike ride. Prefer a swim? The community pool is just across the private street and an easy stroll away.________________________________________📍 Prime Dune Allen / 30A LocationParadise Pete’s is in a charming cul-de-sac of just 5 cottage-style homes, tucked away yet close to everything:• Walkable beach access• Near Gulf Place Town Center• Close to Oyster Lake (fishing & nature views)• Minutes from Topsail Hill Preserve State Park (hiking & trails)Explore all that Scenic Highway 30A offers — sugar-white sand beaches, emerald waters, boutique shopping, award-winning dining, biking, kayaking, fishing, and more.________________________________________❄️ Snowbirds Welcome!Low Monthly Winter Rates (November–February)✔ Monthly stays must begin/end on the 1st of the month✔ $150 additional monthly cleaning fee applies✔ Alternate dates require pre-approval📩 Contact us for a personalized quote — we’re happy to help!________________________________________⚠️ Important Notes• Minimum age to rent: 25 (No exceptions)• Professionally managed for a worry-free stay• 24/7 guest support included________________________________________✨ Paradise Pete’s is where beach days turn into lifelong memories. Book your 30A getaway today and experience the perfect blend of relaxation, comfort, and coastal charm. Read less
